scoring_justification: The agent runs full DFT geometry optimizations with Quantum ESPRESSO; recomputing energies and structural parameters from raw DFT output files is computationally infeasible in the verifier sandbox. The checker compares the agent's extracted values in the JSON artifacts to the paper's reported reference values with domain-appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold reference values for geometric parameters and formation energies against which agent-reported values are compared with tolerances.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'Strain engineering on graphene towards tunable and reversible hydrogenation' (arXiv:0904.2938). All geometric values taken verbatim from the paper text: a_g=2.44 Å, a_sym=2.79 Å, a_asym=2.50 Å, corrugation=0.45 Å, C-C bond=1.52 Å, C-C-C angle=111.6°, H-C-C angle=107.3°, E_f_sym_0=-1.044 eV/CH, E_f_asym_0=-2.847 eV/CH. E_f_sym_strained derived from the paper's stated 53.89% change at 10% strain: -1.044 × 1.5389 ≈ -1.606 eV/CH.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted directly from the paper's reported results (text and figures). The strained formation energy is computed from the paper's own reported percentage change applied to the zero-strain value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Every gold value is the paper's own published number, traceable to specific sentences/figures in the source. The strained energy is algebraically derived from the paper's stated percentage change, not invented independently.

outputs.description: Optimized geometric parameters of pristine graphene and symmetric/anti-symmetric graphane phases.
Formation energies of graphane phases at zero strain and at 10% biaxial tensile strain.

output_contract.notes: Check compares agent-reported values to paper-reported gold values with tolerances; all values are compared as absolute differences within predefined thresholds.
